records.title: Safety norms for air passengers
details: (a) to (e): M/s Spicejet aircraft VT-SQB on 12.09.2025 while operating flight SEJ-2906 from Kandla- Mumbai was reported loss of RH outboard main wheel during takeoff. The aircraft landed safely at Mumbai. The occurrence is classified as incident under Rule 13(1) of the Aircraft (Investigation of Accidents and Incidents) Rules, 2025 and being investigated by Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).
